import struct
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

def add_xmp_to_jpeg(jpeg_path, copyright_text, creator_text):
    """Add XMP metadata to JPEG with copyright and creator"""
    data = bytearray(Path(jpeg_path).read_bytes())
    
    # Create XMP packet
    xmp = f'''<?xpacket begin="﻿" id="W5M0MpCehiHzreSzNTczkc9d"?>
<x:xmpmeta xmlns:x="adobe:ns:meta/" x:xmptk="XMP Core 6.0.0">
 <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#">
  <rdf:Description rdf:about=""
    xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
    xmlns:xmpRights="http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/rights/">
   <dc:rights>
    <rdf:Alt>
     <rdf:li xml:lang="x-default">{copyright_text}</rdf:li>
    </rdf:Alt>
   </dc:rights>
   <dc:creator>
    <rdf:Seq>
     <rdf:li>{creator_text}</rdf:li>
    </rdf:Seq>
   </dc:creator>
   <xmpRights:Marked>True</xmpRights:Marked>
  </rdf:Description>
 </rdf:RDF>
</x:xmpmeta>
<?xpacket end="w"?>'''.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Build APP1 XMP segment
    xmp_header = b'http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/\x00'
    xmp_payload = xmp_header + xmp
    xmp_length = len(xmp_payload) + 2
    
    if xmp_length > 65535:
        print(f"  XMP too large: {xmp_length} bytes")
        return False
    
    app1_segment = b'\xFF\xE1' + struct.pack('>H', xmp_length) + xmp_payload
    
    # Insert after SOI (first two bytes)
    new_data = data[:2] + app1_segment + data[2:]
    
    Path(jpeg_path).write_bytes(new_data)
    return True

def add_xmp_to_png(png_path, copyright_text, creator_text):
    """Add XMP to PNG via iTXt chunk"""
    data = bytearray(Path(png_path).read_bytes())
    
    # Check PNG signature
    if data[:8] != b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
        print(f"  Not a valid PNG")
        return False
    
    # Create XMP
    xmp = f'''<?xpacket begin="﻿" id="W5M0MpCehiHzreSzNTczkc9d"?>
<x:xmpmeta xmlns:x="adobe:ns:meta/" x:xmptk="XMP Core 6.0.0">
 <rdf:RDF xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#">
  <rdf:Description rdf:about=""
    xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
    xmlns:xmpRights="http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/rights/">
   <dc:rights>
    <rdf:Alt>
     <rdf:li xml:lang="x-default">{copyright_text}</rdf:li>
    </rdf:Alt>
   </dc:rights>
   <dc:creator>
    <rdf:Seq>
     <rdf:li>{creator_text}</rdf:li>
    </rdf:Seq>
   </dc:creator>
   <xmpRights:Marked>True</xmpRights:Marked>
  </rdf:Description>
 </rdf:RDF>
</x:xmpmeta>
<?xpacket end="w"?>'''.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Build iTXt chunk
    keyword = b'XML:com.adobe.xmp\x00'
    compression = b'\x00'  # uncompressed
    compression_method = b'\x00'
    language = b'\x00'
    translated = b'\x00'
    
    chunk_data = keyword + compression + compression_method + language + translated + xmp
    chunk_length = len(chunk_data)
    
    # Calculate CRC
    import zlib
    crc = zlib.crc32(b'iTXt' + chunk_data) & 0xffffffff
    
    chunk = struct.pack('>I', chunk_length) + b'iTXt' + chunk_data + struct.pack('>I', crc)
    
    # Insert before IEND (last 12 bytes)
    new_data = data[:-12] + chunk + data[-12:]
    
    Path(png_path).write_bytes(new_data)
    return True

def add_xmp_to_webp(webp_path, copyright_text, creator_text):
    """Add XMP to WebP"""
    data = bytearray(Path(webp_path).read_bytes())
    
    # Check WebP signature
    if data[:4] != b'RIFF' or data[8:12] != b'WEBP':
        print(f"  Not a valid WebP")
        return False
    
    # Create XMP

# Check that image data (SOS to EOI) is unchanged by comparing with a hash

    """Get hash of the compressed image data between SOS and EOI"""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    
    # Find SOS marker (start of scan)
    sos_pos = None
    i = 2
    while i < len(data) - 1:
        if data[i] == 0xFF:
            marker = data[i+1]
            if marker == 0xDA:  # SOS
                # Skip segment length
                length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                sos_pos = i + 2 + length
                break
            if marker not in [0xD8, 0xD9, 0x00]:
                length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                i += 2 + length
            else:
                i += 2
        else:
            break
    
    # Find last EOI
    eoi_pos = data.rfind(b'\xFF\xD9')
    
    if sos_pos and eoi_pos and sos_pos < eoi_pos:
        image_data = data[sos_pos:eoi_pos]
        return len(image_data), hashlib.md5(image_data).hexdigest()
    return None, None

def get_png_idat_hash(path):
    """Get hash of PNG IDAT chunks"""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    
    i = 8  # skip signature
    idat_data = b''

        if i + 8 > len(data):

        length = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4], 'big')
        chunk_type = data[i+4:i+8]
        
        if chunk_type == b'IDAT':
            idat_data += data[i+8:i+8+length]
        elif chunk_type == b'IEND':
            break
        
        i += 12 + length
    
    return len(idat_data), hashlib.md5(idat_data).hexdigest()

            return len(vp8_data), hashlib.md5(vp8_data).hexdigest()
